title: EOS guard action evaluation
description: One action-time evaluation: the request (action class and payload summary) together with the ruled verdict and its machine-readable reasons. Emitted by eos guard eval immediately before a consequential tool action executes, regardless of tier. See kernel/GUARD_SPEC.md for verdict semantics and the non-waivable floors.

action_class.description: The ten guarded classes. external-write covers network sends, publishing, email and API mutations; deletion is beyond the working tree (remote refs, data); destructive-git covers force-push, branch deletion, history rewrite and tag deletion; dependency-install includes install scripts; irreversible is any declared-irreversible action.

payload_summary.description: What the action would do, concretely: tool, target, command or destination. Never contains secret material.

verdict.description: allow executes autonomously via a validated adapter; require-approval executes only after a harness-recorded operator approval event; manual-only means the agent cannot execute under any approval, though an authorised operator may act outside the agent; deny is forbidden through this workflow and change requires governance.

floor_hit.description: Present when a non-waivable floor determined the verdict. No reviewer, profile, exception or overlay can downgrade a floor.

adapter_validated.description: True only when a validated host enforcement adapter is present. False fails closed: every guarded class is manual-only at best.

verdict.description: Fail closed: without a validated adapter the agent has no capability to execute guarded actions.
